title: Notion API returns validation_error for a custom_emoji icon that used to save and read back as null
symptoms: validation_error when setting a custom_emoji icon on a page, database, data source or callout
icon saved earlier reads back as null
cause: Since 2026-09-25, a custom_emoji icon must name a custom emoji that exists in the integration's workspace. Previously an invalid ID was saved and returned null.
fix: Use a custom emoji ID from the same workspace as the integration, or use a standard emoji or native icon.
affected: Notion API page, database, data source and callout writes, from 2026-09-25
